articles.summary: Citius Oncology, Inc. ("Citius Oncology" or the "Company") (Nasdaq: CTOR), an oncology-focused biopharmaceutical company and majority-owned subsidiary of Citius Pharmaceuticals, Inc. ("Citius Pharma") (Nasdaq: CTXR), today announced preliminary, unaudited LYMPHIR ® (denileukin diftitox-cxdl) unit sales to U.S. wholesalers and institutional vial orders for the fiscal fourth quarter ended September 30, 2026. "The fiscal fourth quarter showed continued institutional demand for LYMPHIR. Unit sales to wholesalers more than doubled as our expanded commercial team reached nationwide coverage in August," said Leonard Mazur, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Citius Oncology. "We are now more than halfway to our goal of having LYMPHIR on formulary at 100 priority institutions by calendar year-end. As we enter fiscal 2027, we expect the momentum we built in the fourth quarter to carry forward, with growing institutional demand, deeper penetration into academic and community treatment
articles.title: Citius Oncology Reports Continued Institutional Demand and 120% Growth in Shipments of LYMPHIR® Units to U.S. Wholesalers During the Fiscal Fourth Quarter of 2026
